en.html:
Her voice carried a trace of hesitation.

Sakurako Okabe was what remained of a warrior house that had raised arms against the shogunate, been branded traitors, and been destroyed.

For anyone in Rokuhara's service, going near her would never count as a benefit.

The same held for us, who had to play obedient minor officials.

...Even so, I nodded. Ichijou did the same beside me.

en.html:
Bad. This was bad.

It had come so suddenly that I had failed to stop her.

The question was unforgivably rude. But if it were taken as plain rudeness, a Rokuhara official mocking the defeated, that could still be survived.

But Ichijou cannot hide her feelings.

Anyone could see it. The girl was not speaking from the victor's side. She was standing on the Okabe princess's side and asking from there.

Under no reading was that the conduct of a shogunate official.

まずい。
　不意のことで、止め損ねた。

　あまりに無礼である――だが単なる無礼、六波羅の
役人の敗者への嘲弄と受け止められるなら、まだいい。
　しかし。

　一条は感情を隠せない。
　誰が見ても明らかだった。少女は勝者の立場で口に
していない。むしろ逆、岡部の姫の側に立って、問い
掛けている。

　断じて、幕府の役人のすべき事ではなかった。

en.html:
The princess could not possibly have failed to understand. Confusion shook in her eyes.

I had no words to patch things up. There was nothing to do. I kept my iron face and watched in silence.

Ichijou, perhaps realizing at last what she had said, lowered her gaze.

What the princess saw in her, and what conclusion she reached, I could no longer tell.

When her lips opened again, the voice that came out carried no shine of feeling. But it was not empty. There was something solid in it.

言われた当の姫に、それが理解できなかったはずも
ない。双眸が困惑に揺れる。
　俺は取り繕う言葉を持ち合わせなかった。仕方ない。
鉄面皮を通して、無言のまま行方を見守る。

　一条は――流石にまずいことを言ったという自覚は
あったのか、眼差しを伏せている。
　姫がその姿に何を見て、どう結論したのかはもはや
わからない。

　再びその唇が開かれた時、零れ出た声に情感の色艶
はなかった。
　だが決して空虚ではなかった。堅牢な何かがあった。

en.html:
Sakurako"I am one who was defeated. I do not intend to say anything beyond that."
Ichijou"..."
Sakurako"A warrior house that has fought and lost keeps silent and bows its head to the victor. That is our custom. An argument must be made before the fighting begins. Eloquence after defeat earns only the name of shamelessness."
Sakurako"I shall not speak. Not one word from this mouth. So that the name of Okabe is not shamed. Not about Rokuhara... nor about my father."
Sakurako"Nor about what my father... was thinking when he chose to fight...!"
Kageaki"............"
Ichijou"..."
Ichijou"...I'm sorry..."
